messages:
jordan.k: Quick handoff — I'm logging off in ~30m. Primary oncall for OpalRetail go-live + load test tomorrow 2026-03-18 10:00 UTC. Leaving consolidated notes below, please skim and flag anything I missed.

mira.t: thanks — leaving in good hands. do we have a runbook link?

jordan.k: Runbook: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/opal-retail-launch (TL;DR below). Key points: dedicated pool 'opal-prod' (8xA100), SLA 99.95% for token latency p95, plan is to prime KV cache 30m before test, and route heavy paths to quantized model variant if latency >200ms.

samuel.p: noted. Who will be cover at 09:30 UTC for priming step?

jordan.k: priya.s will do priming. Priya — steps: 1) increase pre-warm clients 50 -> 200 2) run prefix load command 3x with seq len 1024. Command:
```bash
curl -X POST https://loadgen.redwood/api/prime -H "Authorization: Bearer $LOAD_TOKEN" -d '{"pool":"opal-prod","clients":200,"seq_len":1024}'
```
Expect ~15m to finish.

priya.s: got it, will kick off 09:25 UTC and post results here. Any special tokens or headers?

jordan.k: use LOAD_TOKEN_OPAL (shared in 1Password folder Opal/Load). Watch GPU utilization and kv_hit_rate metric in console. If kv_hit_rate < 0.85 after priming, do a second run.

lee_ops: small FYI — we have an open maintenance window on zone-us-east-2 for nvlink firmware 03/18 04:00-06:00 UTC but it's completed. Confirmed with infra that nothing remains.

mira.t: is the cadence for fallback to hosted variants still auto? i.e. if pool saturates, route to opal-quant-hosted?

jordan.k: yes, autoswap policy: route->opal-quant-dyn (lower cost quantized hosted variant) when queued_requests > 400 for 30s. Oncall should not disable the policy unless asked by Prod Eng.

samuel.p: any specific alerting thresholds to watch?

jordan.k: Alerts to watch:
- opal-prod/token_latency_p95 > 220ms (pager)
- opal-prod/queued_requests > 500 (pager)
- opal-prod/gpu_util_avg > 95% for 2m (pager)
- opal-prod/kv_hit_rate < 0.8 (page to SRE only, warn oncall)

oncall-bot: Reminder: Scheduled load test for 'OpalRetail' at 2026-03-18 10:00 UTC. Automated notification sent to #eng-oncall.

priya.s: priming started at 09:25 UTC. First run completed, kv_hit_rate=0.88, avg_latency=180ms. Posting logs to /tmp/prime-opal-20260318.log

lee_ops: good numbers. I will keep watch on network egress. If egress surpasses 2.5Gbps sustained, consider throttling loadgen and open a ticket with infra.

mira.t: jordan, i can take 10:00-12:00 UTC oncall tomorrow if you want to swap the main window. i have overlap with product for rollout.

jordan.k: perfect — swapping. I'll be reachable via DMs for 30m then offline. Mira, please set yourself as primary in the oncall rota.

mira.t: set. changed status and updated rota -> screenshot uploaded to the rota system.

samuel.p: one more ask — OpalRetail has an SLA clause about 95th percentile latency and contractual credit thresholds. If we see sustained p95 > 250ms for >15m, mark customer-impact and escalate to Engagement (cc @cs-lead).

jordan.k: added escalation note in the runbook section "Contract SLA steps". Sam, can you ping @cs-lead if we hit that?

samuel.p: yep.

priya.s: priming second run completed at 09:43 UTC (kv_hit_rate=0.90, latency p95=165ms). I'll standby at 09:50 for any pre-test checks.

mira.t: thanks everyone. I'll take the 10:00 window and post status every 15m during the test. If anything spikes I'll escalate per runbook.

jordan.k: thanks team — leaving final note: if autoswap happens frequently, temporarily increase opal-prod burst capacity by +2 nodes instead of immediately increasing hosted fallback. Steps in runbook under "Burst ops". See y'all Monday.
